This is the website of the **Statistical Models and Applications in
Economics and Environmental Sciences** course (X CFU) of the B.Sc. in
"*Economics and Science for Environmental Sustainability*", Università
degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca.

::: callout-warning
#### Work in progress

This page is [under construction]{.blue}. Teaching material will be posted
here as the course progresses.
:::

## Software

-   **R** is open source and can be downloaded at
    <https://cloud.r-project.org>.
-   The use of **RStudio** is optional but strongly recommended:
    <https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/>.
-   The documentation of the **R** software is an integral part of the
    teaching material.
